items.title: New npm Supply Chain Attack Uses undicy-http to Deploy Screen-Streaming RAT and Browser Injector
items.description: A malicious npm package named undicy-http has surfaced inside the Node.js developer ecosystem, quietly compromising machines of developers who mistakenly install it. The package impersonates undici, the official HTTP client library bundled with Node.js that handles millions of weekly downloads. items.title: PNG Vulnerabilities Allow Attackers to Trigger Process Crashes, Leak Sensitive Information
items.description: Two high-severity vulnerabilities have been discovered in libpng, the widely used reference library for reading and writing PNG images. These flaws allow attackers to trigger process crashes, leak sensitive information, and potentially execute arbitrary code by convincing a system to process a crafted PNG file.
